_comment: Every non-generated media asset the video pipeline is allowed to use, with its license. quality_check.py's copyright gate reads this file and fails the run if assemble_video.py (or any future stage) references something not listed here — so adding real B-roll or music later requires deliberately logging its license here first, rather than silently shipping unlicensed content.
_tts_note: Microsoft Edge neural voices (via the free edge-tts library) are usable for this kind of content; they are not a cloned or impersonated real person's voice.

approved_fonts.name: DejaVu Sans
approved_fonts.source: system font, bundled with most Linux distros

_broll_and_music_note: Empty by design — the current pipeline generates its background/visuals entirely from code (gradients, text, charts), so there is no external footage or music to license yet. If you add stock B-roll or music later (see production pipeline README's 'how to upgrade' section), add an entry here for every asset: {"file": "...", "source": "Pexels/Pixabay/YouTube Audio Library/etc", "license": "...", "url": "..."}. quality_check.py will fail closed if it finds referenced media that isn't logged here.
